summary.text: Robin Grammer is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 6 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The district elects three delegates, and he is on the November ballot with fellow Republican incumbents Bob Long and Ric Metzgar and Democrats Artus Huffman, Megan Ann Mioduszewski and Rayneika Rob.
A former steelworker and operations engineer, he serves on the Environment and Transportation Committee.

paragraphs.text: Robin Grammer was born in Essex, Maryland, and attended Eastern Technical High School.
He earned an associate degree in computer science from the Community College of Baltimore County.
His legislative biography lists him as a former steelworker at Worthington Industries and a former operations engineer at Comcast.
Ballotpedia says Grammer assumed office on January 14, 2015.
The General Assembly website lists him as a member of the Environment and Transportation Committee.
